build_QueryAndGroup: build a QueryAndGroup module to group 3D points using ball query or kNN sampling with configurable radius
build_GroupAll: build a GroupAll module to group all xyz coordinates with optional features into a single tensor
run_grouping_operation: run the grouping_operation function to gather features by indices using CUDA-accelerated forward and backward passes
review_QueryAndGroup_forward: review the QueryAndGroup forward method that performs ball query or kNN and returns grouped xyz and features
test_GroupAll_forward: test the GroupAll forward method that concatenates xyz coordinates with features and returns grouped output
